excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: I'm not talking about archive nodes, just regular RPC fulfilling nodes which require full state (stateless doesn't help them).  You are correct that we have been ignoring this problem for a very long time with no clear roadmap to fix it and it has been getting progressively worse over time.

But anyway, data access cost increases logarithmically so it unlikely it will have a significant performance impact (esp. read-only actions). It should grow similarly to block importing

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: It is not solved in the real world. Proofs are too expensive, there is no incentive for running a server, if you send full call you lose privacy, and if you only request state as needed response time is horrible due to many round trips per request (and you still lose some privacy).
